name: Carbonaceous Asteroid
info: Normal RU capacity, standard extraction/refining rate, common, and resistant.
description: An asteroid is a minor planet of the inner Solar System. Sizes and shapes of asteroids vary significantly, ranging from 1-meter rocks to a dwarf planet almost 1000 km in diameter; they are rocky, metallic or icy bodies with no atmosphere.
